title: Peer Socket Service State
description: Establishes a named peer-to-peer WebSocket connection for sending or receiving pipeline data between boards or runtimes. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/peer-socket)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

mode.description: Whether the service sends, receives, or both

targetPeer.description: Name of the peer to send to (in Send or Receive and Send modes)

extractIncomingData.description: When true, only the data field of the incoming message is injected into the pipeline

peerPort.description: Port override for the peer server

peerHost.description: Host override for the peer server

peerPath.description: Path override for the peer server WebSocket endpoint
